verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-resource API operations, such as creating balance accounts with the Configuration API and managing legal entities, but no documented bulk or batch endpoint for acting on many items in one operation. Applying a managed payout schedule to balance accounts with the same location and currency is a recurring payout configuration, not a bulk-operations capability. Splitting one payment across users is also a different feature. Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payments platform, so absence of evidence means none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
